title: A Love That Never Stops
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Far from their homes the people walked
And wondered, "Are we known?"
They felt forgotten, small and sad,
And very much alone.

[Chorus]
"I've loved you with a love that lasts
And never, ever ends;
With lovingkindness I have drawn
You close, My little friends."

[Verse 2]
Then Jeremiah brought the word
From Heavenly Father's heart,
A promise older than the hills
That nothing pulls apart.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
A new boy sat alone one day;
Our Willow did not pull.
She shared her crayons, half and half,
Till both their hands were full.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
"I'll build you up again," He said,
"Your broken walls will stand,
And you will dance for joy once more
Across the sunny land."

[Chorus]
mood: Drawing-close music. A slow, even pull under the voice, like a hand that gathers rather than tugs, the same gentle pull in every bar. A cello holding one long warm note under a fingerpicked guitar that answers it, the two in quiet conversation. It starts far off and small, and with each verse the cello comes nearer, until the last chorus is close enough to lean on, warm and unhurried, never loud.
